components.name: Container
components.summary: Centred wrapper with a maximum width and horizontal padding.
components.plain: Centred wrapper with a maximum width and horizontal padding.

components.name: Row
components.summary: Horizontal flex layout. It stays a row at every width unless `.stacks` or a responsive `direction` says otherwise.
components.plain: Horizontal flex layout. It stays a row at every width unless .stacks or a responsive direction says otherwise.

props.name: direction:
props.meaning: Which way its children run; takes a value per breakpoint

props.name: stacks:
props.meaning: Reflow on a narrow screen: a Row becomes a column, a Grid one column

components.name: Column
components.summary: A child of the 12-column grid, spanning `span` columns.
components.plain: A child of the 12-column grid, spanning span columns.

props.name: span:
props.meaning: How many of the 12 grid columns to span

props.name: stacks:
props.meaning: Reflow on a narrow screen: a Row becomes a column, a Grid one column

components.name: Grid
components.summary: CSS grid with a fixed number of columns.
components.plain: CSS grid with a fixed number of columns.

props.name: stacks:
props.meaning: Reflow on a narrow screen: a Row becomes a column, a Grid one column

components.name: Stack
components.summary: Vertical flex layout.
components.plain: Vertical flex layout.

components.name: Spacer
components.summary: Vertical space; `md` when no size is given.
components.plain: Vertical space; md when no size is given.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Horizontal rule.
components.plain: Horizontal rule.

components.name: Navbar
components.summary: Top navigation bar with brand, links and action areas.
components.plain: Top navigation bar with brand, links and action areas.

parts.name: Navbar.Brand
parts.summary: The brand area, usually a link home.

parts.name: Navbar.Links
parts.summary: The navigation links; collapses behind a toggle on small screens.

parts.name: Navbar.Actions
parts.summary: Buttons at the end of the bar.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: Side navigation. A `Sidebar.Item` whose `to` matches the current route is marked `.active` and `aria-current="page"`.
components.plain: Side navigation. A Sidebar.Item whose to matches the current route is marked .active and aria-current="page".

props.name: to:
props.meaning: Route to navigate to; the link whose `to` matches the current route carries `.active` and `aria-current="page"`

props.name: active:
props.meaning: How the link decides it is the current one

parts.name: Sidebar.Divider
parts.summary: A rule between groups of items.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Client-side navigation link; its label or its block is the link text.
components.plain: Client-side navigation link; its label or its block is the link text.

props.name: to:
props.meaning: Route to navigate to; the link whose `to` matches the current route carries `.active` and `aria-current="page"`

props.name: active:
props.meaning: How the link decides it is the current one

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tab strip switching between its pages.
components.plain: Tab strip switching between its pages.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Breadcrumb trail. An item without `to` is the current page.
components.plain: Breadcrumb trail. An item without to is the current page.

props.name: to:
props.meaning: Route to navigate to; the link whose `to` matches the current route carries `.active` and `aria-current="page"`

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Menu opened by a trigger button.
components.plain: Menu opened by a trigger button.

props.name: trigger:
props.meaning: Label of the button that opens the menu

parts.name: Menu.Divider
parts.summary: A rule between groups of entries.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Card surface with optional header, body and footer sections.
components.plain: Card surface with optional header, body and footer sections.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Data table. Cells inside `Table.Head` render as `<th scope="col">`; `caption` is the table's accessible name, visually hidden.
components.plain: Data table. Cells inside Table.Head render as <th scope="col">; caption is the table's accessible name, visually hidden.

props.name: caption:
props.meaning: Accessible name of the table (rendered visually hidden)

parts.name: Table.Head
parts.summary: Header section; its cells become `<th scope="col">`.

parts.name: Table.Cell
parts.summary: A cell. `header` makes it a `<th>` anywhere, as `Table.Head` does for its cells.

components.name: List
components.summary: List of its children; `ordered` for a numbered list.
components.plain: List of its children; ordered for a numbered list.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small status label.
components.plain: Small status label.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Compact chip.
components.plain: Compact chip.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A picture of a person, or their initials.
components.plain: A picture of a person, or their initials.

props.name: initials:
props.meaning: Letters shown when there is no image

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Shows `text` when its child is hovered or focused.
components.plain: Shows text when its child is hovered or focused.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text field. With `label`, `hint` or `error` it is a labelled field.
components.plain: Text field. With label, hint or error it is a labelled field.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

props.name: hint:
props.meaning: Help text under the control, linked to it by `aria-describedby`

props.name: error:
props.meaning: Error text (a string; empty when there is none): announced as it appears and sets `aria-invalid`

props.name: placeholder:
props.meaning: Hint shown while the field is empty

props.name: value:
props.meaning: The control's value, when its state is not bound

props.name: required:
props.meaning: Whether the form refuses to submit without it

components.name: Select
components.summary: Drop-down of `Select.Option` children.
components.plain: Drop-down of Select.Option children.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: value:
props.meaning: The control's value, when its state is not bound

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

props.name: hint:
props.meaning: Help text under the control, linked to it by `aria-describedby`

props.name: error:
props.meaning: Error text (a string; empty when there is none): announced as it appears and sets `aria-invalid`

parts.name: Select.Option
parts.summary: One choice: the visible label, and the value sent with the form.

props.name: value:
props.meaning: The value `bind` takes when this one is chosen; the label when absent

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox bound to a boolean state.
components.plain: Checkbox bound to a boolean state.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: checked:
props.meaning: Whether it is checked, when its state is not bound

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: Radio
components.summary: One choice of a group; every radio bound to the same state is one group.
components.plain: One choice of a group; every radio bound to the same state is one group.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: value:
props.meaning: The value `bind` takes when this one is chosen

props.name: checked:
props.meaning: Whether it is checked, when its state is not bound

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: Switch
components.summary: On/off toggle bound to a boolean state.
components.plain: On/off toggle bound to a boolean state.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: checked:
props.meaning: Whether it is checked, when its state is not bound

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Range input. `aria-*` arguments reach the input; with `aria-valuetext` the raw number is not shown beside the track.
components.plain: Range input. aria-* arguments reach the input; with aria-valuetext the raw number is not shown beside the track.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Date input.
components.plain: Date input.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: File input; handle the chosen files in `on change`.
components.plain: File input; handle the chosen files in on change.

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

components.name: Form
components.summary: Groups controls; `on submit` runs when it is submitted, and the page never navigates away.
components.plain: Groups controls; on submit runs when it is submitted, and the page never navigates away.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: A handle on the form: `form.valid`, `form.errors`, `form.values` by field name, `form.reset()`, `form.apply(serverErrors)`

props.name: show:
props.meaning: When a `validate` block's message is shown

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Several lines of text. With `label`, `hint` or `error` it is a labelled field; with `maxLength` it counts what is left.
components.plain: Several lines of text. With label, hint or error it is a labelled field; with maxLength it counts what is left.

props.name: bind:
props.meaning: State variable the control reads and writes (two-way)

props.name: label:
props.meaning: Visible label; also the control's accessible name

props.name: hint:
props.meaning: Help text under the control, linked to it by `aria-describedby`

props.name: error:
props.meaning: Error text (a string; empty when there is none): announced as it appears and sets `aria-invalid`

props.name: placeholder:
props.meaning: Hint shown while the field is empty

props.name: required:
props.meaning: Whether the form refuses to submit without it

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline notice; a `danger` or `warning` one is announced as an alert.
components.plain: Inline notice; a danger or warning one is announced as an alert.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Temporary notification.
components.plain: Temporary notification.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Modal `<dialog>`, opened by a state flag; the browser supplies focus trapping and Escape.
components.plain: Modal <dialog>, opened by a state flag; the browser supplies focus trapping and Escape.

props.name: visible:
props.meaning: State flag that opens and closes it

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Confirmation `<dialog>`, opened by a state flag.
components.plain: Confirmation <dialog>, opened by a state flag.

props.name: visible:
props.meaning: State flag that opens and closes it

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Loading indicator, announced as a status.
components.plain: Loading indicator, announced as a status.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Progress bar; a `value` that reads state moves with it.
components.plain: Progress bar; a value that reads state moves with it.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.
components.plain: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button. Its block holds what it shows; `on click` what it does.
components.plain: Button. Its block holds what it shows; on click what it does.

props.name: to:
props.meaning: Route to navigate to; the link whose `to` matches the current route carries `.active` and `aria-current="page"`

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Icon-only button. `label` is its accessible name, never visible text.
components.plain: Icon-only button. label is its accessible name, never visible text.

props.name: icon:
props.meaning: One of the built-in icon names

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Buttons joined into one row.
components.plain: Buttons joined into one row.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: Button that opens a menu of `Dropdown.Item`s.
components.plain: Button that opens a menu of Dropdown.Items.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Label of the button that opens it

parts.name: Dropdown.Divider
parts.summary: A rule between groups of entries.

components.name: Image
components.summary: Image; `alt` is required for accessibility (rule A01). Given an `image` the program declares, it becomes a `<picture>` with every width the build wrote.
components.plain: Image; alt is required for accessibility (rule A01). Given an image the program declares, it becomes a <picture> with every width the build wrote.

props.name: source
props.meaning: An `image` the program declares, or a URL

props.name: sizes:
props.meaning: How wide it will be shown, so the browser picks a width: `(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 1200px`

props.name: placeholder:
props.meaning: What fills the box while the image loads

props.name: alt:
props.meaning: Text alternative; empty for a purely decorative image

props.name: loading:
props.meaning: Unset, the first image on a page is eager at high priority and the rest lazy

components.name: Video
components.summary: Video player. Without `captions` it draws an `A09` warning: a video nobody can hear is a video nobody can follow.
components.plain: Video player. Without captions it draws an A09 warning: a video nobody can hear is a video nobody can follow.

props.name: poster:
props.meaning: The frame shown before it plays

props.name: playsinline:
props.meaning: Play where it sits, rather than full screen

props.name: captions:
props.meaning: A WebVTT file of captions, which becomes a `<track>`

components.name: Audio
components.summary: Audio player. `transcript` links what was said, which is what a reader who cannot hear it needs.
components.plain: Audio player. transcript links what was said, which is what a reader who cannot hear it needs.

props.name: transcript:
props.meaning: A link to what was said, shown beneath the player

components.name: Icon
components.summary: One of the built-in SVG icons, rendered inline.
components.plain: One of the built-in SVG icons, rendered inline.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Slide track with named controls and dots; optional autoplay.
components.plain: Slide track with named controls and dots; optional autoplay.

components.name: Text
components.summary: A paragraph of text. `{…}` in the string reads state and stays live.
components.plain: A paragraph of text. {…} in the string reads state and stays live.

components.name: Heading
components.summary: Heading; `level` picks the tag (`h2` when none is given).
components.plain: Heading; level picks the tag (h2 when none is given).

props.name: level:
props.meaning: Heading level: the tag, and its place in the outline

components.name: Code
components.summary: Inline code, or a code block with `block`; `language:` colours it.
components.plain: Inline code, or a code block with block; language: colours it.

props.name: language:
props.meaning: Colours the code as this language: `wf`, `json`, `bash` or `css`

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Markdown text rendered as HTML: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, links, emphasis. The text is escaped first, so HTML in it is shown, not run.
components.plain: Markdown text rendered as HTML: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, links, emphasis. The text is escaped first, so HTML in it is shown, not run.

components.name: Host
components.summary: An element handed to somebody else's code, with a lifetime. `mount:` runs once with the node, `update:` again whenever the state it reads changes, and `cleanup:` when the page, branch or list item it belongs to leaves.
components.plain: An element handed to somebody else's code, with a lifetime. mount: runs once with the node, update: again whenever the state it reads changes, and cleanup: when the page, branch or list item it belongs to leaves.

props.name: mount:
props.meaning: `(node) => …` — run once with the element, giving back whatever the library hands over

props.name: update:
props.meaning: `(handle) => …` — run again whenever the state it reads changes

props.name: cleanup:
props.meaning: `(handle) => …` — run when what owns it leaves, so nothing is left behind

props.name: tag:
props.meaning: The element to make, `div` by default

components.name: Unsafe
components.summary: The one door for markup a page did not write. It has a single part, `Unsafe.Html`.
components.plain: The one door for markup a page did not write. It has a single part, Unsafe.Html.

parts.name: Unsafe.Html
parts.summary: Markup, put in as markup. It is **not** sanitised — the name says so — and `sanitize(…)` is one call away for anything the project did not write itself.

components.name: Blockquote
components.summary: Quotation: the text, or its block as the quoted content.
components.plain: Quotation: the text, or its block as the quoted content.

components.name: Document
components.summary: Root of a PDF document.
components.plain: Root of a PDF document.

components.name: Section
components.summary: Groups content with spacing; on the web, a `<section>`.
components.plain: Groups content with spacing; on the web, a <section>.

components.name: Paragraph
components.summary: Block of text with paragraph spacing.
components.plain: Block of text with paragraph spacing.

components.name: Header
components.summary: Repeated at the top of every PDF page; a `<header>` on the web.
components.plain: Repeated at the top of every PDF page; a <header> on the web.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: Repeated at the bottom of every PDF page; a `<footer>` on the web.
components.plain: Repeated at the bottom of every PDF page; a <footer> on the web.

components.name: PageBreak
components.summary: Forces a new PDF page.
components.plain: Forces a new PDF page.

components.name: Presentation
components.summary: Root of a slide deck; its children must be slides.
components.plain: Root of a slide deck; its children must be slides.

components.name: Slide
components.summary: One slide, one PDF page; content is top-aligned and clipped at the bottom margin.
components.plain: One slide, one PDF page; content is top-aligned and clipped at the bottom margin.

components.name: TitleSlide
components.summary: Cover slide: title and subtitle, vertically centred.
components.plain: Cover slide: title and subtitle, vertically centred.

components.name: SectionSlide
components.summary: Full-bleed coloured band with a centred label.
components.plain: Full-bleed coloured band with a centred label.

components.name: TwoColumn
components.summary: Two equal columns; takes exactly two `Container` children.
components.plain: Two equal columns; takes exactly two Container children.

components.name: ImageSlide
components.summary: Image slide with an optional caption.
components.plain: Image slide with an optional caption.

components.name: Router
components.summary: Where the current page renders. May sit at any depth inside `app`; pages declare their own paths.
components.plain: Where the current page renders. May sit at any depth inside app; pages declare their own paths.

props.name: transition:
props.meaning: How a route change moves between pages

props.name: duration:
props.meaning: How long each half of the transition plays, e.g. `200ms`

props.name: animate:
props.meaning: Animation played when the element appears

props.name: exit:
props.meaning: Animation played when the element leaves

props.name: easing:
props.meaning: How the animation is paced — a named easing, or any CSS timing function

props.name: stagger:
props.meaning: Delay added per item of a list, e.g. `50ms`

props.name: count:
props.meaning: How long the number it shows takes to count to a new value, e.g. `600ms`

props.name: shared:
props.meaning: A name this element keeps across a route change, so the browser carries it from one page to the next

props.name: class:
props.meaning: Classes added beside the engine's, from the project's own stylesheets

props.name: ref:
props.meaning: A handle on the element, usable as the element: `ref: nameInput`, then `nameInput.focus()`

events.name: on click
events.meaning: The element was clicked or activated

events.name: on input
events.meaning: The value changed, on every keystroke

events.name: on keydown
events.meaning: A key went down; `e.key` names it
